# Structured header names are eager arrays despite the retained enumerator wording

headerNames returns Array<AUTF8String>, and MimeStructuredHeaders creates it by copying its Map keys. The extension can call flatMap directly and MimeMessage can iterate the returned array without a second spread. Snapshot behavior now belongs to that getter; do not remove copies from unrelated producers by analogy. The IDL's Retrieve an enumerator wording is stale and should describe the array while keeping its header-case caveat. No MIME or extension test ran.

Scope: MIME header collection API and compose callers.
